title: The Divine Engine
description: The mod adds Industrialization, a couple of new ores, machines, structures, and some other things (The mod was made on MCreator by a newbie)
body:
**The Divine Engine is a mod that adds a short story arc related to deities and an ancient race.**

Using new ores mined in the mod's caves, you can craft tools, machines, and armor. You'll also likely find three new structures throughout the game that will allude to the ancient race.

The mod's main goal is to introduce you to the new storyline, which will be updated gradually.

The mod adds an achievement chain that can serve as a guide throughout the mod; you can progress from sticks and stones to electricity (the mod is currently in development).

This mod is currently only compatible with the Forge version, but the author may add other versions soon.

You can also join our Discord community at this link: https://discord.gg/vzdVKHksw

If you find any errors or bugs, please report them immediately on GitHub at this link. https://github.com/alsasmidt7-svg/The-Divine-Engine/issues
